usedFor: Close logs your sales calls and CallHippo handles texting, so “New Call” can start a follow-up through “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Call” in Close, then “Send SMS” in CallHippo
bestTemplate.why: A finished call is the right moment for a follow-up text, sent through your CallHippo account.

watchOut: “New Call” fires when a call is created or completed, so “Send SMS” can text the same person twice.
